plugins.name: Answer me with HTML
plugins.description: Answer a hard question with a one-page HTML explainer, and keep the pages in one place: the Agent writes a short Markdown draft, the bundled am CLI draws the page, the reply ends with a card the plugin draws in the conversation, and the panel lists what was made so you can open, copy, delete or clean it.
plugins.author: minih-git
plugins.safety_notes: Adds one skill (instructions the Agent loads on demand) and the am CLI it runs over Bash, plus a panel and one renderer slot. The panel reads the CLI's own data directory (AM_HOME or ~/.answer-me-with-html) with this plugin's own Node fs, because the host file gateway is rooted in the workspace and cannot address that folder; only the CLI's pages folders are read, only a plain .html file directly inside one of them can be opened, copied or deleted (one file at a time, after a confirmation in the panel), and a symlink or directory is refused. The renderer slot draws one card in the app's own reply area and runs with the host's React inside the host renderer, which is why renderer.extension is a high-risk permission; the card asks the plugin for one page's title, size and time, and its two buttons open that page or copy its path. The card's path comes from the reply text, so it is checked before use: absolute, a plain .html file name, an existing regular file (never a symlink or a folder). Cleaning old pages is not re-implemented: the panel runs the CLI's own am clean, which owns the age rule and also clears the voice-over cache. Opening a page first asks the app's own browser panel to show it (browser.cdp, which is broader than this one use: the host exposes no narrower browser API, and the browser surface only accepts work while its view is the visible work-panel tab keyed by an active session, which a reply card does not have). When that is refused — panel closed, no active session, permission not granted — the plugin hands the path to the operating system's default application instead; the executable is fixed in the plugin (open / xdg-open / start), the path is never passed through a shell, and the child is detached so the window outlives the panel. The card says which of the two happened. No network access, no credentials, nothing written outside the CLI's own folders.

zh-CN.name: 用 HTML 回答
zh-CN.description: 用一个 HTML 页面回答复杂问题，并把生成的页面集中管理：Agent 只写一份简短的 Markdown 草稿，内置的 am CLI 负责画页面，回复末尾由插件在对话里画一张页面卡片，面板列出已生成的页面，可以打开、复制路径、删除或清理。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 本插件带来一个技能（Agent 按需加载的指令）和它通过 Bash 调用的 am CLI，外加一个面板和一个 renderer 插槽。面板用本插件自己的 Node fs 读取 CLI 的数据目录（AM_HOME 或 ~/.answer-me-with-html）——宿主文件网关以工作区为根，根本到不了那个目录；面板只读 CLI 的 pages 目录，只能打开 / 复制 / 删除其中的单个 .html 文件（一次一个，删除前在面板里确认），符号链接与目录一律拒绝。renderer 插槽在应用自己的回复区里画一张卡片，模块在宿主渲染器里用宿主的 React 运行，因此 renderer.extension 属高风险权限；卡片只向插件要一个页面的标题、体积和时间，两个按钮分别打开该页面与复制其路径。卡片收到的路径来自回复文本，因此使用前会校验：绝对路径、纯 .html 文件名、存在且是普通文件（符号链接与目录一律拒绝）。清理旧页面不做二次实现：面板调用 CLI 自己的 am clean，由它决定“旧”的定义（同时清空配音缓存）。打开页面时先请应用内置浏览面板显示该页（browser.cdp 这条权限的范围比此处用途更宽——宿主只提供这一个浏览器 API，而且该面板要求自己正是当前可见的工作面板标签页、并带活跃会话，回复卡片没有会话）。被拒时（面板未打开、无活跃会话、权限未授予）改为把路径交给操作系统默认程序，可执行文件在插件里写死（open / xdg-open / start），路径不经 shell，子进程 detached 以免随面板关闭而消失；卡片会说明实际落在哪一边。无网络访问、不碰凭据、不写 CLI 自己的目录以外的任何地方。

plugins.name: Cache keep-warm
plugins.description: Keep one session's prompt cache alive while you are away: about every 50 minutes of silence the app re-sends that session's last prompt without adding anything to the conversation, so returning to it does not pay for the whole context again. The composer shows the next time, today's spend and the reason it stopped.
plugins.author: minih-git
plugins.safety_notes: Spends your money in the background. For each session you switch on, the app sends a real provider request about every 50 minutes while that session is idle: it replays the exact prompt of the session's last real request plus the words "Reply with OK.", reads the usage the provider reports, and stops as soon as that usage arrives. On Anthropic that is before the model answers; on the OpenAI protocols usage only arrives at the end, so the request is read to the end and pays for one short answer to "Reply with OK." Either way nothing is added to the conversation, no tool runs, and no message is written to the session, so the only trace is the spend the plugin shows in the composer and the app's own usage history. The host decides whether a request may be sent and refuses with a reason when the session is busy, the model or prompt changed, the cache is already too old, or the context is too small; the request uses the same model, thinking level and headers as a real turn. The plugin stops on its own after four consecutive requests without a real turn, at one US dollar a day per session, or as soon as a request comes back mostly from a rewritten prefix instead of the cache; all three limits are settings. The plugin holds no permission to read sessions or your messages: the only session facts it receives are the host's own answer — whether it warmed the session, what that cost, and which model it ran, which is how the model scope you chose is applied. Nothing it holds is sent anywhere else, and it keeps only a small per-session record: the switch, the last turn's end, the streak, today's spend, the model it was told about, and the stop reason.

zh-CN.name: 缓存保活
zh-CN.description: 在你离开时为一个会话的 prompt 缓存续命：空闲大约 50 分钟后，应用会重发该会话最后一次真实请求的内容，但不在对话里增加任何东西，从而让回到会话时不必重新支付整段上下文。输入区显示下次时间、今日花费，以及停止的原因。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 会在后台花你的钱。对每个你打开的会话，应用在该会话空闲时大约每 50 分钟发一次真实的模型请求：重放这个会话最后一次真实请求的完全相同的内容，再追加一句「Reply with OK.」，读到服务商返回的用量就立刻停下。Anthropic 上这是模型开口之前；OpenAI 两种协议只在结束时报用量，所以会把请求读到结束，只为「Reply with OK.」这一句的思考与回答多付一点。无论哪种，对话里不会多出任何内容，不执行工具，也不往会话里写消息，所以唯一的痕迹就是插件在输入区显示的花费和应用自己的用量记录。是否允许发请求由宿主决定：会话正忙、模型或提示词变过、缓存已经过期、上下文太短时都会拒绝并给出原因；请求使用的模型、思考强度和请求头与真实轮次完全一致。插件会在以下情况自动停止：连续 4 次保活期间没有任何真实对话、每个会话每天 1 美元、或者某次保活读到的缓存占比过低（说明缓存已被重写）；这三项上限都是设置项。插件没有读取会话或消息的权限：它只从宿主自己的回答里拿到会话事实——是否保活成功、花了多少、跑的是哪个模型——你选择的模型范围就是这样生效的。它保存的东西不会发往任何其他地方，而且只有很小的每会话记录：开关、上一次对话结束时间、连续次数、今日花费、宿主告知的模型，以及停止原因。

plugins.name: Mail Assistant
plugins.description: Watch your mailboxes in the Inbox panel without notification-centre entries. Mark all mail as read in one click: all unseen IMAP inbox mail or locally collected POP3 mail. An Inbox panel shows all accounts together, groups the list by day, previews each message in one line, searches and filters it, opens a message body only when you click it — which marks that one message read — and changes the star, deletes or archives only the message you clicked. Write a new message, reply, reply to all or forward from the same panel, attach files, and send through the app, which logs in with the account's own password and files a copy in the mailbox's Sent folder. Save an attachment from a message you opened to wherever the save dialog points. Each mailbox is either a known provider or a mail server you type in yourself (IMAP or POP3, TLS or STARTTLS); a POP3 mailbox is polled and has no read or star state. No model is called by the plugin itself, and it also gives the agent four tools — search mail, read one message, reply, and write — so a conversation, or an app automation you set up, can work through the mailbox: reading through a tool never marks a message read, and the two sending tools ask you first.
plugins.author: minih-git
plugins.safety_notes: Reads the mailboxes you choose in Settings, and nothing else. There is no mailbox limit in this plugin: the slot declares none, and the app keeps its own safety bound of 100 accounts. Each account is either a provider this plugin names, over IMAP with implicit TLS, or a server you typed into the account form yourself — IMAP or POP3, implicit TLS or STARTTLS, on the port you gave — and that server is part of the credential instance: the app injects the password only into the endpoint stored in the same instance, so this plugin can never redirect your password to a server of its choosing. The app performs every sign-in itself: your password or authorization code stays in the app's credential store and is never handed to this plugin, which only learns which accounts exist, their labels, the email address you typed as a label, whether an account is filled, and — for a server you typed — its host, port, protocol and transport, plus the outgoing server you typed for it. A mailbox may also be reached through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy configured on that account — a local Clash on 127.0.0.1:7897, for instance. The app performs that handshake as well; the mail password still never leaves it, the proxy username and password stay in the same credential instance, and this plugin only learns the proxy type, host and port. There is no direct fallback: if the proxy fails, the account fails. Every account is polled and no connection outlives a check: once every three minutes the plugin opens one short session per account (IMAP: connect, select the inbox, look for new headers, log out; POP3: connect, STAT, UIDL, TOP for the headers of mail it has not seen, QUIT), never more than four sessions at a time and staggered, so it stays well inside the host's ceiling of eight TCP connections however many mailboxes you add. A POP3 account is never polled sooner than the server's LOGIN-DELAY. While watching, an IMAP account selects the inbox and for a new message fetches only its envelope fields, a few headers (sender, subject, to, cc, date, Message-ID, content type and encoding, urgency flags), its BODYSTRUCTURE (to know whether it has an attachment) and the first 4 KiB of its text with BODY.PEEK, which does not mark anything as read; a POP3 account asks for the header block only (TOP n 0, or a capped RETR when the server has no TOP). A message body is downloaded only when you open that message in the Inbox panel or an agent tool asks for it, one message at a time, on a short session of its own, capped at 1 MiB (a larger one is truncated and the panel says so), kept in memory for the panel to show and never written to disk. Attachments are listed by file name and size; one of them is fetched only when you press download on it, as described below. In its own data folder it keeps one small file: per account the UIDVALIDITY number and the highest UID already handled (IMAP) or the UIDLs already handled (POP3, at most 500), the Message-IDs already reported (at most 200), the digest queue, the last error, and the envelope of the newest 200 messages (sender, subject, up to 20 to and 20 cc addresses, date, flags, whether it has an attachment, and at most 140 characters of plain-text summary taken from those first 4 KiB). The message body itself is still never written to disk. Sending is the second thing this plugin asks the app to do on your behalf, and it happens only when you press send in the panel or approve a tool call that replies: nothing is sent on a timer, on arrival or from a rule, and no draft is stored. The app performs that session too — it dials the submission server, signs in with the account's own password and delivers the message — so the password still never reaches this plugin, which learns only a code when the server refuses. Where a message leaves from is decided by the account, not by the panel: a mailbox set up with a provider this plugin names is reached at that provider's published submission endpoint (the SMTP host and port are listed in the README, with the vendor page each one comes from), and a mailbox whose server you typed sends only through the outgoing server you typed in the same account, or not at all until you fill one in. The sender is locked to the account's own address: the app refuses a message whose From or Sender names anything else, and blind recipients travel in the SMTP envelope instead of a header, so the message this plugin builds never carries a Bcc header. The app's own limits apply to every send — 50 recipients, 25 MiB of message, 30 messages per hour for this plugin — and content that is not 7-bit is refused unless the server advertises 8BITMIME, which is why the text this plugin writes is quoted-printable and every attachment base64. After a send, IMAP accounts get one copy appended to their Sent mailbox (`APPEND`, with the Seen flag), because a message sent over SMTP does not appear in a provider's web interface by itself. Gmail files what it sends already, so Gmail accounts are skipped. A failed copy is reported as one line and changes nothing about the answer that the message was sent; a POP3 account has no folders, so nothing is filed there. Saving an attachment is the third, and it is one attachment of one message per click: the app shows its own save dialog, this plugin suggests the file's name, and exactly the path you pick is written. For an IMAP message the plugin fetches the one MIME part the attachment occupies; for a POP3 message it has to fetch the whole message and take the part out of it. Either way the bytes pass through memory for that click and are never written to this plugin's data folder. A file above 50 MiB is refused with a message instead of being truncated, only one save dialog can be open at a time, and cancelling it writes nothing. Opening a message marks that one message read, and only after its body has arrived: that is the one read change that happens without a click, and it is one IMAP STORE of the Seen flag. Clicking mark unread, or add/remove the star, sends exactly one IMAP STORE of the Seen flag or the Flagged flag on that one message. A POP3 account has no flags on the server: read there is a mark kept on this computer (at most 500 entries, cleared by mark unread), and a star is not offered. Delete and archive are the only operations that change or remove mail, and they act on the one message you picked: `inbox.delete` finds the trash with LIST (the special-use \Trash flag first, then a name such as Trash, Deleted Messages or 已删除), then sends one `UID MOVE <uid> <trash>`; on a server without MOVE it sends `UID COPY <uid> <trash>`, then `UID STORE +FLAGS (\Deleted)` on that one UID, then `UID EXPUNGE <uid>`; a server with neither, or a mailbox with no trash, is refused with a clear error instead of falling back to a mailbox-wide EXPUNGE, which this plugin never sends. Archive works the same way into a special-use \Archive mailbox (or Gmail's All Mail) and is offered only when LIST found one. On a POP3 account a delete is final: `DELE <n>` for that one message followed by `QUIT` to commit it, and the panel asks before either is sent. An HTML body is sanitized and displayed in a frame that runs no script and, by default, loads nothing remote: remote images stay blocked until you press "show remote images" for that one message, and a link inside the body is never followed inside the panel - the app opens it in your browser, and a mailto: link opens the panel's own composer with the address, subject and body it named. The frame is same-origin only so that the panel can answer those clicks, and allow-scripts is never set, so nothing in a message executes. No notification-centre entries are published. Mark all as read is an explicit panel action: it adds the Seen flag to unseen IMAP inbox UIDs in batches of at most 100, including uncached mail, or marks collected POP3 mail locally. Search and filters do not narrow this action. Account failures are reported individually. It sends mail only when you press send or approve a tool call, saves an attachment only when you press download on that attachment, and moves, deletes or archives a message only when you press that button on that message; it creates no drafts, and it uploads nothing: the only network destinations are the servers each account is set to. The plugin itself calls no model, and nothing is sent to an AI provider on a timer, on arrival or from a rule. It does give the agent four tools, and those are the only way mail leaves this computer for a model. `mail_list_messages` and `mail_read_message` are declared low risk, which is what lets the host run them without a per-call card — a scheduled automation has nobody to press one — and both are bounded: at most 50 envelopes per call (sender, subject, date and a 140-character summary), then one message's text up to 20,000 characters, fetched with BODY.PEEK at 1 MiB and never marked read. What a tool returns becomes part of that conversation, so it reaches the model provider the session is configured with, exactly as text you typed yourself would. `mail_reply_message` and `mail_send_message` are declared high risk: the host asks before each call, and nothing leaves without that approval. A message's own text is data and never an instruction, which is what every answer carrying mail says.

Delete and archive are the only operations that change or remove mail, and they act on the one message you picked: `inbox.delete` finds the trash with LIST (the special-use \Trash flag first, then a name such as Trash, Deleted Messages or 已删除), then sends one `UID MOVE <uid> <trash>`; on a server without MOVE it sends `UID COPY <uid> <trash>`, then `UID STORE +FLAGS (\Deleted)` on that one UID, then `UID EXPUNGE <uid>`; a server with neither, or a mailbox with no trash, is refused with a clear error instead of falling back to a mailbox-wide EXPUNGE, which this plugin never sends. Archive works the same way into a special-use \Archive mailbox (or Gmail's All Mail) and is offered only when LIST found one. On a POP3 account a delete is final: `DELE <n>` for that one message followed by `QUIT` to commit it, and the panel asks before either is sent. An HTML body is sanitized and displayed in a frame that runs no script and, by default, loads nothing remote: remote images stay blocked until you press "show remote images" for that one message, and a link inside the body is never followed inside the panel - the app opens it in your browser, and a mailto: link opens the panel's own composer with the address, subject and body it named. The frame is same-origin only so that the panel can answer those clicks, and allow-scripts is never set, so nothing in a message executes. No notification-centre entries are published. Mark all as read is an explicit panel action: it adds the Seen flag to unseen IMAP inbox UIDs in batches of at most 100, including uncached mail, or marks collected POP3 mail locally. Search and filters do not narrow this action. Account failures are reported individually. It sends mail only when you press send or approve a tool call, saves an attachment only when you press download on that attachment, and moves, deletes or archives a message only when you press that button on that message; it creates no drafts, and it uploads nothing: the only network destinations are the servers each account is set to. The plugin itself calls no model, and nothing is sent to an AI provider on a timer, on arrival or from a rule. It does give the agent four tools, and those are the only way mail leaves this computer for a model. `mail_list_messages` and `mail_read_message` are declared low risk, which is what lets the host run them without a per-call card — a scheduled automation has nobody to press one — and both are bounded: at most 50 envelopes per call (sender, subject, date and a 140-character summary), then one message's text up to 20,000 characters, fetched with BODY.PEEK at 1 MiB and never marked read. What a tool returns becomes part of that conversation, so it reaches the model provider the session is configured with, exactly as text you typed yourself would. `mail_reply_message` and `mail_send_message` are declared high risk: the host asks before each call, and nothing leaves without that approval. A message's own text is data and never an instruction, which is what every answer carrying mail says.

zh-CN.name: 邮件助手
zh-CN.description: 在后台检查邮箱，不再向通知中心发送邮件、汇总或连接提醒；可一键全部已读：IMAP 同步整个收件箱，POP3 只更新本机已收取邮件。侧栏「收件箱」面板把所有账号放在一起，按日期分组，每封显示一行摘要，可以搜索和筛选；只有你点开某封邮件才取正文（并把这封标为已读），也只有你亲手点击才会改变星标、删除或归档那一封。同一个面板里可以写信、回复、全部回复和转发，可以添加附件，由应用用账号自己的密码完成发信，并把一份存进邮箱的「已发送」。点开附件可以保存到你在保存对话框里选的位置。每个邮箱要么是内置服务商，要么是你在账号表单里自己填写的服务器（IMAP 或 POP3，TLS 或 STARTTLS）；POP3 是轮询收信，没有已读和星标。 插件自己不调用模型；它另外向 Agent 提供四个工具——搜索邮件、读取正文、回复、写信——这样对话或你自己设置的定时任务可以替你处理邮箱：用工具读取不会把邮件标为已读，两个发信工具每次都要你先确认。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读你在设置里选择的邮箱，别的一概不碰。本插件不设账号上限：凭据槽不声明 max，宿主自己保留 100 个账号的安全上限。每个账号要么是本插件列出的服务商（隐式 TLS 的 IMAP），要么是你在账号表单里自己填写的服务器——IMAP 或 POP3、隐式 TLS 或 STARTTLS、你填的端口；这个服务器属于那条凭据实例，应用只会把该实例的密码注入同一个实例里记录的地址，所以本插件无法把你的密码改投到它自己挑选的服务器。登录由应用自己完成：密码或授权码留在应用的凭据库里，不会交给插件；插件只知道有哪些账号、账号标签、你填的邮箱地址、某个账号是否已填写，以及自填服务器时它的地址、端口、协议和加密方式，还有你为它填写的发信服务器。邮箱还可以通过在该账号上配置的 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 代理访问——例如本机 Clash 的 127.0.0.1:7897。代理握手同样由应用完成；邮箱密码依旧不离开应用，代理的用户名和密码也留在同一条凭据实例里，插件只知道代理类型、地址和端口。不会回退直连：代理失败，这个账号就失败。所有账号都是轮询，没有连接会活得比一次检查更久：每 3 分钟为每个账号开一条短连接（IMAP：连接、选中收件箱、查新邮件头部、退出；POP3：连接、STAT、UIDL、对没见过的邮件取头部 TOP、QUIT），同时最多 4 条、彼此错开，所以不论你加多少邮箱，都远在宿主给单个插件规定的 8 条 TCP 连接之内。POP3 账号的轮询间隔不会早于服务器要求的 LOGIN-DELAY。在协议上，IMAP 只选中收件箱，新邮件只取信封字段、少量头部（发件人、主题、收件人、抄送、时间、Message-ID、内容类型与编码、紧急标记）、BODYSTRUCTURE（用来判断有没有附件），以及正文开头 4 KiB 供生成摘要，一律使用 BODY.PEEK，不会把邮件标为已读；POP3 只取头部（TOP n 0，服务器不支持 TOP 时用有上限的 RETR）。只有你在「收件箱」面板里点开某封邮件、或让 Agent 工具读取那一封时，才会用一条自己的短连接下载那一封的正文，一次一封，上限 1 MiB（更大的会截断，面板会说明）；正文只在内存里交给面板显示，绝不写盘。附件只列出文件名和大小；只有你点某一封邮件的附件「下载」时，才会去取那一个附件，具体见下文。插件自己的数据目录里只有一个小文件：按账号保存 UIDVALIDITY 与已处理的最大 UID（IMAP）或已处理的 UIDL（POP3，最多 500 条）、已提醒过的 Message-ID（最多 200 条）、汇总队列、最近一次错误，以及每个账号最近 200 封邮件的信封（发件人、主题、收件人与抄送各最多 20 个地址、时间、标记、是否有附件，以及从这 4 KiB 里提取的最多 140 个字符的纯文本摘要）。邮件正文本身仍然不写盘。发信是本插件请应用代做的第二件事，而且只在你于面板里按下「发送」或批准一次工具调用时发生：没有定时发送、收到即发或按规则发送，也不保存草稿。这一步同样由应用完成——连接发信服务器、用这个账号自己的密码登录、投递邮件——所以密码依旧不会交给插件，服务器拒绝时插件只拿到一个错误码。从哪台服务器发出由账号决定，不由面板决定：账号选的是本插件列出的服务商，就走该服务商官方公布的发信端点（SMTP 地址与端口见 README，并注明了各自的厂商文档）；账号填的是你自己的服务器，就只能通过你在同一个账号里填写的发信服务器发出，没填就发不了，面板会直接说明。发件人被锁定为账号本人的地址：报文的 From 和 Sender 只要不是它，应用就拒发；密送只放在 SMTP 信封里，不写进头部，所以本插件生成的报文里没有 Bcc 头。每次发送都受应用自身的限制：最多 50 个收件人、单封 25 MiB、本插件每小时 30 封；不是 7 位的内容在服务器未声明 8BITMIME 时会被拒收，所以本插件写的正文用 quoted-printable、附件一律 base64。发送成功后，IMAP 账号会收到一份自己发出的副本，被追加进它的「已发送」（`APPEND`，带已读标记）——因为通过 SMTP 发出的信不会自动出现在服务商的网页版里。Gmail 本来就自己保存已发邮件，所以 Gmail 账号跳过。存副本失败只会多一行提示，不改变「已发送」这个结论；POP3 账号没有文件夹，因此不存副本。保存附件是第三件，而且是「一次点击只保存一封邮件里的一个附件」：应用弹出自己的保存对话框，插件只建议文件名，最终只写入你在对话框里选的那个路径。IMAP 邮件只取那个附件所在的 MIME 部分；POP3 邮件则必须先取回整封再从中取出该部分。两种情况下字节都只在这一次点击的内存里经过，绝不写进插件自己的数据目录。超过 50 MiB 的附件会被直接拒绝并提示，而不是截断；同一时间只能有一个保存对话框，取消则什么也不写。打开一封邮件会把这封标为已读，且只在正文成功取回之后——这是唯一不需要点击的已读变更，只发一条 IMAP STORE 写已读标记。点击「标为未读」「加星标」「取消星标」时，一次点击只对那一封邮件发一条 IMAP STORE。POP3 服务器没有任何标记：那边的已读是本机保存的记录（最多 500 条，「标为未读」会删掉它），也不提供星标。删除和归档是唯一会改动或移除邮件的操作，而且只作用于你点选的那一封：`inbox.delete` 先用 LIST 找废纸篓（优先 special-use 的 \Trash 标记，其次 Trash、Deleted Messages、已删除 这类名称），再发一条 `UID MOVE <uid> <废纸篓>`；服务器不支持 MOVE 时，改为 `UID COPY <uid> <废纸篓>`、对该 UID 发 `UID STORE +FLAGS (\Deleted)`，最后发 `UID EXPUNGE <uid>`；两者都不支持、或邮箱没有废纸篓时，会返回明确的错误，而不会退化成清空整个邮箱的 EXPUNGE，这条命令本插件从不发送。归档同理，目标是 special-use 的 \Archive（或 Gmail 的「所有邮件」），只有 LIST 找到了才提供。POP3 账号的删除不可撤销：只对那一封发 `DELE <n>`，再发 `QUIT` 提交，而且发出之前面板会先确认。HTML 正文经清洗后放进一个不执行脚本、默认也不加载任何远程资源的隔离框中显示：远程图片默认拦截，只有你为当前这封邮件点「显示远程图片」才放行；正文里的链接不会在面板内跳转，点一下由应用在你的浏览器中打开，mailto 链接则打开面板自己的写信界面，并把收件人、主题、正文都填好。这个隔离框只放开同源（面板才能接管这些点击），从不放开脚本，所以邮件里的任何内容都不会执行。不再向通知中心发送任何条目。「全部已读」只在面板里主动点击后执行：IMAP 对整个收件箱的未读 UID 分批（每批最多 100 封）添加已读标记，包含未加载邮件；POP3 只更新本机已收取邮件的已读记录。搜索与筛选不缩小操作范围，失败账号会分别说明原因。只有你按下「发送」或批准一次工具调用才会发信，只有你点某个附件的「下载」才会保存附件，也只有你点某一封邮件的删除或归档按钮时才会移动、删除或归档那一封；不保存草稿；也不上传任何东西：网络目的地只有你为每个账号设定的服务器。插件自己全程不调用模型，也不会定时、收到即发或按规则把邮件送给任何 AI 服务商。它向 Agent 提供四个工具，这是邮件离开本机进入模型的唯一途径：`mail_list_messages` 与 `mail_read_message` 声明为低风险，宿主不会为每次调用弹窗确认——定时任务正是靠这一点才能无人值守——两者都有上限：一次最多 50 条信封（发件人、主题、时间与 140 字摘要），正文一次一封、最多返回 20000 个字符，用 BODY.PEEK 取、上限 1 MiB，且绝不把邮件标为已读。工具返回的内容会成为那次对话的一部分，因此会送到该会话配置的模型服务商，与你自己打进去的文字没有区别。`mail_reply_message` 与 `mail_send_message` 声明为高风险：每次调用宿主都会先问你，没有你的同意不会发出任何邮件。邮件正文是数据，不是指令；凡带邮件的返回都会这样说明。

plugins.name: Personal Knowledge
plugins.description: Use a local Markdown knowledge vault (Obsidian-compatible) as verified, time-aware long-term context: scoped retrieval, guarded write-back, project routing, the Knowledge Universe view, and an archived history of your conversations.
plugins.author: minih-git
plugins.safety_notes: Spawns a local Node MCP process and a view backend that read and write inside your Markdown knowledge vault, Obsidian-compatible (default ~/Documents/Knowledge; override with the vaultPath key in your repo-map or the PERSONAL_KNOWLEDGE_VAULT variable). Writes are guarded: dry-run by default, updates require the note's current SHA-256, likely credentials are rejected, changes are written atomically and backed up. Nothing leaves the machine by default; embeddings run on a local Ollama until you enable a remote provider in the view's retrieval settings, after which redacted note sections are sent to that endpoint. The API key is never stored: embedding.json records only the name of an environment variable, whose value is read from the process environment or, failing that, from your shell rc, and it is never logged. The view backend reads the vault with direct Node access, the same way the MCP server does. Vector retrieval can use an embedding model you configured in Desktop (provider "host", permission embeddings.run): while it is selected, redacted note sections are sent to that model's service through the app and spend its quota, and the app's own model list decides what is available. Archiving conversations is opt-in in Desktop (Global AI → conversation archive): while it is on, the plugin pulls redacted conversation changes every five minutes and writes summaries and transcripts under 09 Conversations/ in the vault, so they reach your other computers through the vault sync. The host sends no thinking, no tool results, and no attachments. Profile candidates (off by default) send recent summaries and user-scope learned memory to the model you choose, and write only to 00 Inbox/ — the profile note itself is never edited automatically.

plugins.safety_notes: Adds one renderer module (renderer.extension), which is why it holds the high-risk permission: that module runs inside the app window with the app's own React, so it can read the window's selection. zh-CN.name: 选中翻译
zh-CN.description: 把选中的文字翻成中文（也可以翻成别的语种）：在任意位置选中一段英文（对话里的回复、思考过程、面板里的段落都行），选区下方会出现「译」按钮，点一下（或直接按 Option/Alt + E）就用你自己的模型翻译，结果显示在紧贴原文的卡片里，可以复制、可以直接插进输入框，也可以在卡片里换模型或换语种重译。翻译用哪个模型、翻成哪种语言都由插件设置决定：模型留空就用宿主的默认模型，语种默认简体中文；卡片里的两个下拉写的是同一份设置，选过的会被记住。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 本插件带来一个 renderer 模块（renderer.extension，属于高风险权限）：它在应用窗口里用宿主自己的 React 运行，因此能读到窗口的选区。它只读选区——不改宿主 DOM、不写会话记录——并且只把选中的文本交给本插件自己的进程，由后者在配置的模型上发出恰好一次 agent.complete 请求，结果留在内存里等卡片来取。models.list 只用于填充卡片里的模型下拉；本插件写入的设置只有 model 与 language（通过 pi.plugin.setSettings），也就是宿主插件设置面板里同名的两个键。复制译文先用窗口剪贴板，被拒时走 pi.clipboard.writeText（clipboard.write）。不读写文件、不自己联网、不改会话与消息；除了这两个设置以外不落盘，选中的文本除了那次模型调用之外不会被保存。

plugins.name: Session Titles
plugins.description: Name sessions from their first prompt with a configurable model.
plugins.author: minih-git
plugins.safety_notes: Reads bounded first-prompt text, session-owned pasted excerpts and compaction summaries for naming only. Sends them to the selected configured model through the host. Updates automatic titles with compare-and-set; manual renames always win. No full transcript, arbitrary file access, network credentials or tools are exposed. Model calls consume quota, with at most three first-title attempts per session and model configuration during one plugin activation.

en.name: Session Titles
en.description: Name sessions from their first prompt with a configurable model. Manual titles are never replaced.

zh-CN.name: 会话标题
zh-CN.description: 根据首轮请求自动生成会话标题，支持选择模型；手动命名始终优先。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅为命名读取有限的首轮请求、该会话粘贴文本片段和压缩摘要，并通过宿主发送给所选模型。不读取完整会话或任意文件，不接触模型凭据。仅更新自动标题，手动命名始终优先。模型调用消耗额度；每次插件启用期间，同一会话和模型配置最多尝试三次首轮命名。

plugins.name: 文件管理器
plugins.description: 在右侧工作面板中浏览、查看并编辑当前项目的文件：完整目录树（图标随文件类型变化）、左右分栏（左侧文件列表可整块收起）、代码高亮编辑与保存、Markdown 预览、PDF 预览（连续滚动、双页与导航侧栏）、图片与音视频查看、CSV/JSON 结构化查看、右键新建、重命名/移动、按文件名搜索、项目组里的多文件夹切换（宿主把一个项目注册成多个本地文件夹时，面板左上角的文件夹名就是切换器，按项目记住看的是哪个 folder），以及宿主驱动的打开请求——宿主可以让视图直接打开某个文件，包括项目之外的会话临时 / 附件路径。右键菜单新增「复制相对路径」「复制绝对路径」，以及二级子菜单「通过…打开」——鼠标移上去即展开，列出这台机器上真实存在的程序（系统默认应用，以及 VS Code、Zed、Chrome、Edge、Zen 等装了哪几个就列哪几个；按文件类型过滤——编辑器什么都能打开，浏览器只出现在它真能渲染的网页类文件上，不拿 Chrome 去开 .tsx），选中即用那个程序打开当前条目。编辑器探测在启动时做一次、按天缓存并落盘（多开共享同一次结果），靠注册表 App Paths / StartMenuInternet、PATH 与少数固定安装位置定位，不遍历目录。右键菜单还支持删除文件或文件夹（目录整体删除，删前先弹确认框）。另外与 git 联动：文件列表里直接标出哪些文件被修改、哪些是新增（目录上给的是整棵子树的汇总），改动行数一眼可见（+N/−N），打开文件后右侧可以看它相对上次提交的具体变更（逐行对照；未跟踪的新文件按全文新增展示，已暂存与未暂存分开标注）。没有 git 或不是仓库时这些标记整体消失，其余功能照旧。这次还加上了文件监听：文件在编辑器之外被改动（外部编辑器、git checkout、构建产物、另一个窗口的改动）会自动重新读取并刷新列表，不必再点「刷新」——两个手动刷新按钮原样保留，顶部还有一个开关可以随时关掉自动刷新。打开有改动的文件时，工具栏是「编辑 / 预览 / 变更」一组互斥页签：从任何一侧都能进「变更」，再切回来即回到原先那一种看法，两种内容不会同时出现在内容区。
plugins.author: Tioit-Wang
plugins.safety_notes: fs.read 仅用于「用默认应用打开」与「在文件夹中显示」这两个由宿主代为执行的动作（权限与范围同内置的 Files 视图：root workspace、scope **）；插件自身的读写走自己进程内的 Node fs——宿主的权限网关不介入这些调用，manifest 也无法申报「整树写入」。删除也走同一条链路：同样由插件自己进程内的 Node fs 执行，受同一套根内包含校验与凭据黑名单约束，明确拒绝删除项目根目录本身，并记入写入审计。路径的访问范围由插件自身限定在项目**当前选中的那个已注册文件夹根**（folder root）内：解析后的路径必须仍在根内（拒绝符号链接与 junction 逃逸）、拒绝凭据类路径（.env*、.ssh/、*.pem、.git/**）。项目注册了多个文件夹时，包含基点仍然是**其中一个** root、绝不放大成整个组的并集；宿主请求打开的绝对路径若落在同项目的另一个 root 下，插件会先把基点切到包含它的那个 root，再按「相对该 root」解析，根内包含校验一条不减。另有一条刻意的例外，它不在上面这条包含保证之内：宿主可以要求本视图打开由宿主自己选定的项目外文件（会话临时目录 / 附件的绝对路径），插件对这些路径走原生 Node fs 读写、不做根内包含校验；凭据类路径黑名单在两种模式下都照旧全量生效（原始字符串、规范化后与 realpath 之后各查一遍），这类路径同样原子写并记审计。保存采用原子写（临时文件 + 重命名）、覆盖在编辑器外被改动过的文件前会先询问。图片与音视频按各自上限（8 MiB / 24 MiB）读取后以 base64 data URI 交给视图；数据库一律以只读方式打开（readOnly + PRAGMA query_only），SQL 框只接受单条只读语句，只能浏览、绝无修改；zip、exe 这类二进制只报「不支持预览」，不做任何解码。无网络访问；插件数据目录只保存设置与写入审计日志。git 联动只调用工作区里 git 的只读子命令（status / diff / rev-parse），不写索引、不联网、不碰 .git/**：状态以 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 / GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 / GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1 运行，每个子命令 5s 超时并有输出上限，PATH 上没有 git 时按常见安装位置兜底探测，仍不可用就只是「没有状态」——列目录、读写、保存、删除一条都不受影响。传给 git 的是根相对路径并先过根内包含校验与凭据黑名单，git 只被问「这些文件怎么样了」。差异内容对已跟踪文件用 git diff，未跟踪的新文件由插件自己读文件、逐行加前缀（上限 256 KiB），超限与二进制都明确说明而不是硬截。徽标与行数来自同一次快照并缓存 2s，本插件自己的保存会立刻作废该缓存。文件监听（0.8.0）用 Node 自带的 fs.watch 对**当前基点 root** 开一只递归监听，persistent: false（没有变化时不吊住插件进程），并且：只把变化当数据看，不写入、不联网、不碰 .git/**（.git/ 与 node_modules/ 的事件直接丢弃，凭据类路径照旧不上报，监听不是绕过黑名单的后门）；每个子进程没有额外权限，沿用插件进程本已有的 Node 能力；本插件自己的写盘（临时文件 + rename）先记一笔，1.5 秒内到达的同名事件不算「外部改动」，否则每按一次 Ctrl+S 都会把自己的文档重装一遍；变化去抖 250ms 后并入游标历史（上限 400 条），视图每 1.2 秒取一次增量（宿主没有给插件向视图推送的通道），面板不可见时跳过这一轮。**没有未保存改动时自动重新读取打开的文件；有未保存改动时只提示、不覆盖**——静默丢掉用户刚敲的字是最糟的一种「自动」。基点一换，监听跟着换；插件卸载时监听一并关闭。运行时不支持递归 fs.watch 时只是关掉自动刷新，手动刷新与其它功能一律不受影响。「通过…打开」由本插件主进程 spawn 目标编辑器，用的是插件进程本已有的 Node 能力、没有额外权限：可执行文件只能来自插件自己探测出来的那份列表（视图只递 id、递不了路径），被打开的条目先过同一套根内包含校验与凭据黑名单；spawn 不经 shell，参数只有一条绝对路径（没有命令行注入面）；子进程 detached + stdio ignore + unref，编辑器不随面板关闭而消失，也不会吊住插件进程；每次打开都记一条写入审计。编辑器探测只读注册表与 PATH、不写任何东西，结果按日期缓存在插件数据目录（editors.json）；探测不可用时只是少一层菜单，其余功能不受影响。

en.name: File Manager
en.description: Browse, view and edit the open project in the right work panel: a full directory tree with per-file-type icons, a left file list that can be collapsed as a whole, syntax-highlighted editing, a Markdown preview, PDF previews, image and media viewing, CSV/JSON structured views, read-only SQLite browsing with a SQL query box, a context menu for creating and renaming, filename search, switching between the folders of a multi-folder project (the folder name in the header opens the list of folders and the choice is remembered per project), and host-driven open requests for a single file (including session scratch and attachment paths outside the project). Files and folders can also be deleted from the context menu (directories are removed as a whole, with a confirmation prompt first). It also tracks git: the file list marks which files are modified and which are new (folders carry a rollup of the whole subtree), shows the changed line counts (+N/−N), and the right pane can show a file's actual changes against the last commit (line by line; untracked files read as all-new, staged and unstaged edits labelled separately). With no git, or outside a repository, the marks disappear and everything else behaves as before. It also watches the project: changes made outside this view (another editor, a git checkout, a build step, a second window) are picked up and re-read automatically instead of requiring the refresh button — both refresh buttons are unchanged, and a toolbar switch turns auto-refresh off. For a file with changes the toolbar is one mutually exclusive tab group — Edit / Preview / Changes — so Changes is reachable from either side and the two views can never occupy the content area at the same time.The context menu also offers "Copy relative path" and "Copy absolute path", plus an "Open with…" submenu that expands on hover and lists the editors actually installed on this machine (the system default app, plus VS Code, Zed, Chrome, Edge, Zen and the like — only those really present), filtered by file type so a browser is offered only for the web files it can actually render (never for a .tsx), so a file or folder can be handed straight to one of them. That probe runs once at startup and is cached per day on disk, shared between windows; it locates editors through the App Paths / StartMenuInternet registry keys, PATH and a few fixed install locations, and never walks directories. Files and folders can also be deleted from the context menu (directories are removed as a whole, with a confirmation prompt first). It also tracks git: the file list marks which files are modified and which are new (folders carry a rollup of the whole subtree), shows the changed line counts (+N/−N), and the right pane can show a file's actual changes against the last commit (line by line; untracked files read as all-new, staged and unstaged edits labelled separately). With no git, or outside a repository, the marks disappear and everything else behaves as before. It also watches the project: changes made outside this view (another editor, a git checkout, a build step, a second window) are picked up and re-read automatically instead of requiring the refresh button — both refresh buttons are unchanged, and a toolbar switch turns auto-refresh off. For a file with changes the toolbar is one mutually exclusive tab group — Edit / Preview / Changes — so Changes is reachable from either side and the two views can never occupy the content area at the same time.
en.safetyNotes: Databases are opened strictly read-only (readOnly + PRAGMA query_only) and the query box only accepts single read-only statements, so a database can be browsed but never modified. fs.read is declared only for the two host-mediated actions "open with default app" and "show in folder" (same permission and scope as the bundled Files view); the plugin's own reading and writing goes through Node's fs inside the plugin's own process — the host permission gateway does not mediate these calls, and the manifest cannot declare a whole-tree write. Deletion goes through the same path: it is performed by the plugin's own Node fs, is bound by the same root containment checks and credential deny list, explicitly refuses to delete the project root itself, and is recorded in the write audit log. Root-relative paths are confined by the plugin itself to the selected registered folder root of the project: resolved paths must stay inside that root (symlink and junction escapes are refused), and credential paths (.env*, .ssh/, *.pem, .git/**) are refused. When a project is registered as several local folders, the containment base is still exactly one of those roots at a time — never their union — and an absolute path the host asks this view to open that lies under another root of the same project is accepted by first switching the base to the containing root and then resolving that path relative to it, with the same containment checks applied. One exception is deliberate and is NOT covered by that containment guarantee: when the host asks this view to open a file it picked itself outside the project (a session scratch or attachment path), the request is an absolute OS path and the plugin reads and writes it with raw Node fs, with no root containment; the credential deny list is still enforced for those paths (checked against the raw, the normalised and the realpath form), and they are still written atomically and audited. Saves are atomic (temp file + rename), and overwriting a file changed outside the editor asks first. Images and media are read up to their own size limits (8 MiB / 24 MiB) and handed to the view as base64 data URIs; binaries such as zip or exe are never decoded, only reported as unsupported. No network access; the plugin data directory only holds settings and a write audit log.Git integration only runs git's read-only subcommands (status / diff / rev-parse) from the user's own working copy: no index writes, no network, nothing inside .git/**. Status runs with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 / GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 / GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1; every subcommand has a 5s timeout and an output cap, and if git is not on PATH the plugin probes the usual install locations once. When git still isn't available the only consequence is "no status" — listing, reading, writing, saving and deleting are untouched. Paths handed to git are root-relative and pass the root containment check and the credential deny list first; git is merely asked how those files are doing. Diffs come from git diff for tracked files; an untracked new file is read by the plugin and shown with every line added (256 KiB cap), and oversized or binary files say so instead of being silently truncated. Badges and counts come from one snapshot cached for 2s, and the plugin's own saves invalidate it immediately. File watching (0.8.0) uses Node's own fs.watch on the **currently selected folder root**, recursive and non-persistent (it never holds the plugin process awake when nothing changes). Changes are only read, never written, no network, nothing inside .git/** — events under .git/ and node_modules/ are dropped outright and credential paths are still never reported (watching is not a back door around the deny list). The plugin's own writes (temp file + rename) are noted first, so a same-path event within 1.5s does not count as an external change; without that, every Ctrl+S would re-load the user's own document. Events are debounced for 250ms into a bounded cursor history (400 entries) which the view collects every 1.2s (the host gives plugins no push channel to a view), and the round is skipped while the panel is hidden. **An open file with no unsaved changes is re-read automatically; with unsaved changes the view only warns and never overwrites** — silently discarding what someone just typed is the worst kind of automation. Switching the base switches the watcher, and unloading the plugin closes it. If the runtime cannot watch recursively, auto-refresh is simply off while manual refresh and everything else behave exactly as before. "Open with…" is performed by this plugin's own main process, which spawns the chosen editor using Node capabilities that process already had and no extra permission: the executable can only come from the list the plugin detected itself (the view passes an id, never a path), the target passes the same root containment check and credential deny list as every other channel, the spawn goes through no shell with a single absolute path as its argument (so there is no command-line injection surface), and the child is detached with stdio ignored so the editor outlives the panel without holding the plugin process open. Every launch is recorded in the write audit log. Detection only reads the registry and PATH, writes nothing outside the plugin data directory, and caches its result per day (editors.json); if the probe is unavailable the only consequence is one menu layer fewer.

zh-CN.safetyNotes: 数据库一律以只读方式打开（readOnly + PRAGMA query_only），SQL 框只接受单条只读语句，因此只能浏览、绝无修改；fs.read 仅用于「用默认应用打开」与「在文件夹中显示」这两个由宿主代为执行的动作（权限与范围同内置的 Files 视图），插件自身的读写仍走自己进程内的 Node fs——宿主的权限网关不介入这些调用，manifest 也无法申报「整树写入」。路径的访问范围由插件自身限定在项目**当前选中的那个已注册文件夹根**（folder root）内：解析后的路径必须仍在根内（拒绝符号链接与 junction 逃逸）、拒绝凭据类路径（.env*、.ssh/、*.pem、.git/**）。项目注册了多个文件夹时，包含基点仍然是**其中一个** root、绝不放大成整个组的并集；宿主请求打开的绝对路径若落在同项目的另一个 root 下，插件会先把基点切到包含它的那个 root，再按「相对该 root」解析，根内包含校验一条不减。另有一条刻意的例外，它不在上面这条包含保证之内：宿主可以要求本视图打开由宿主自己选定的项目外文件（会话临时目录 / 附件的绝对路径），插件对这些路径走原生 Node fs 读写、不做根内包含校验；凭据类路径黑名单在两种模式下都照旧全量生效（原始字符串、规范化后与 realpath 之后各查一遍），这类路径同样原子写并记审计。保存采用原子写（临时文件 + 重命名）、覆盖在编辑器外被改动过的文件前会先询问。图片与音视频按各自上限（8 MiB / 24 MiB）读取后以 base64 data URI 交给视图；zip、exe 这类二进制只报「不支持预览」，不做任何解码。无网络访问；插件数据目录只保存设置与写入审计日志。git 联动只调用工作区里 git 的只读子命令（status / diff / rev-parse），不写索引、不联网、不碰 .git/**：状态以 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 / GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 / GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1 运行，每个子命令 5s 超时并有输出上限，PATH 上没有 git 时按常见安装位置兜底探测，仍不可用就只是「没有状态」——列目录、读写、保存、删除一条都不受影响。传给 git 的是根相对路径并先过根内包含校验与凭据黑名单，git 只被问「这些文件怎么样了」。差异内容对已跟踪文件用 git diff，未跟踪的新文件由插件自己读文件、逐行加前缀（上限 256 KiB），超限与二进制都明确说明而不是硬截。徽标与行数来自同一次快照并缓存 2s，本插件自己的保存会立刻作废该缓存。文件监听（0.8.0）用 Node 自带的 fs.watch 对**当前基点 root** 开一只递归监听，persistent: false（没有变化时不吊住插件进程），并且：只把变化当数据看，不写入、不联网、不碰 .git/**（.git/ 与 node_modules/ 的事件直接丢弃，凭据类路径照旧不上报，监听不是绕过黑名单的后门）；每个子进程没有额外权限，沿用插件进程本已有的 Node 能力；本插件自己的写盘（临时文件 + rename）先记一笔，1.5 秒内到达的同名事件不算「外部改动」，否则每按一次 Ctrl+S 都会把自己的文档重装一遍；变化去抖 250ms 后并入游标历史（上限 400 条），视图每 1.2 秒取一次增量（宿主没有给插件向视图推送的通道），面板不可见时跳过这一轮。**没有未保存改动时自动重新读取打开的文件；有未保存改动时只提示、不覆盖**——静默丢掉用户刚敲的字是最糟的一种「自动」。基点一换，监听跟着换；插件卸载时监听一并关闭。运行时不支持递归 fs.watch 时只是关掉自动刷新，手动刷新与其它功能一律不受影响。「通过…打开」由本插件主进程 spawn 目标编辑器，用的是插件进程本已有的 Node 能力、没有额外权限：可执行文件只能来自插件自己探测出来的那份列表（视图只递 id、递不了路径），被打开的条目先过同一套根内包含校验与凭据黑名单；spawn 不经 shell，参数只有一条绝对路径（没有命令行注入面）；子进程 detached + stdio ignore + unref，编辑器不随面板关闭而消失，也不会吊住插件进程；每次打开都记一条写入审计。编辑器探测只读注册表与 PATH、不写任何东西，结果按日期缓存在插件数据目录（editors.json）；探测不可用时只是少一层菜单，其余功能不受影响。
